title: Asymmetric Schiff base-based colorimetric and fluorescent sensor for Al3+ detection in real samples and live-cell bioimaging
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16999-17014
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01372K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ayman A. Abdel Aziz, Ali M. Abdel-Aziz
A promising colorimetric and fluorescent sensor for aluminum ions recognition based on new Schiff base, AMMN. The probe AMMN was utilized for imaging in HeLa cells, confirming its potential as a fluorescent probe for Al3+ monitoring in living cells.
